author: 3owj
content: L58: added sources_ignore_dirs: Vec<String> to VaultConfig (serde default = []). scan_sources_dir gains ignore_dirs: &[String] param; uses WalkDir::filter_entry to prune matching subdirs by name (depth > 0 check avoids filtering the root). Production call site and all 8 test call sites updated. 2 new reconcile tests: ignore_dirs_skips_matching_subdirectory and ignore_dirs_matches_by_name_not_full_path. L57: AI_CONVERSATION_SIDECAR_WORD_THRESHOLD = 2_000. audit_vault gains manifest: &Manifest param; sidecar check loops over manifest.sources filtering for AiConversation kind, checks for {stem}.json alongside the .md, nudges with soft_warning if word_count >= threshold and no json. Removed early return on missing synthetic dir (downstream checks are already no-op safe). audit_cmd.rs updated to pass manifest. 3 new audit tests: warns_when_long_ai_conversation_has_no_sidecar, no_warn_when_json_present, no_warn_for_short_conversation. All existing tests updated to pass empty manifest. 291 unit tests total, all passing.
